propositions: compact.py at 798 LOC exceeds the 800-line cap and bundles three unrelated responsibilities (transaction, snapshot reconstruction, CLI) with high cyclomatic complexity (24 and 21)

splitting compact.py into a CLI facade (≤500 LOC) over two engines requires co-locating _compact_locked, _git, _build_authorship_ledger, and _snapshot_strip_keys in compact_txn.py to avoid circular imports
rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log and its module-global counter _REBUILD_COUNT must live together in compact_rebuild.py, with re-export through compact.py to preserve calling paths
test monkeypatches on _compact._git and _compact.lock must be repointed to compact_txn._git and _lock respectively after the split
all public paths (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, get_rebuild_count) must remain importable from rebar._commands.compact via re-export
